findings.title: Tealium tracking continued despite the cookie-policy choice
findings.detail: After the user selected “Decline optional cookies”, Tealium continued receiving unique browser identifiers and set a new one-year tracking cookie. This conflicts with the cookie notice's description of Tealium's role in respecting consent preferences and its statement that optional cookies require a choice.
